dbqueries.dbquery: SELECT * FROM( SELECT tp.position_id, tp.position_code, tp.position_title, tp.position_level, tp.position_referal_fees, @@ tp.position_note, date_format(tp.position_date_created, '%d-%b-%y') as position_date_created, date_format(tp.website_publish_from_date, '%d-%b-%y') as position_date_published, (select group_concat(DISTINCT tls.location_name) from tp_location_ap tls where tls.location_id in (select tpls.location_id from tp_position_locations tpls where tpls.position_id=tp.position_id )) as location, tp.position_no_of_openings, (select td.dept_name from tp_departments td where td.dept_id=tp.dept_id) as dept_name, (SELECT td.dept_name FROM tp_departments td WHERE tp.sub_dept_id=td.dept_id) AS sub_dept_name, (SELECT td.dept_name FROM tp_departments td WHERE tp.sub_sub_dept_id=td.dept_id) AS sub_sub_dept_name, (SELECT td.dept_name FROM tp_departments td WHERE tp.sub3_dept_id=td.dept_id) AS sub3_dept_name, (SELECT td.dept_name FROM tp_departments td WHERE tp.sub4_dept_id=td.dept_id) AS sub4_dept_name, (tp.position_no_of_openings - (select count(*) from tp_applicant_joining_history ta where ta.position_id = tp.position_id ) ) as unfilled_vacancies, date_format(tp.position_date_expiry, '%d-%b-%y') as expiry_date, (select group_concat(tpsk.skill) from tp_skills tpsk where tpsk.skill_id in (select tppsk.skill_id from tp_position_skills tppsk where tppsk.position_id=tp.position_id and tppsk.skill_type=?)) as primary_skills, (select group_concat(tpsk.skill) from tp_skills tpsk where tpsk.skill_id in (select tppsk.skill_id from tp_position_skills tppsk where tppsk.position_id=tp.position_id and tppsk.skill_type=?)) as secondary_skills, concat(case when ceil(tp.position_min_exp)=floor(tp.position_min_exp) then round(tp.position_min_exp, 0) else format(tp.position_min_exp, 1) end, ' to ', case when ceil(tp.position_max_exp)=floor(tp.position_max_exp) then round(tp.position_max_exp, 0) else format(tp.position_max_exp, 1) end, ' yrs') as experience, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tdgr.degree_title SEPARATOR ', ') AS education, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tbr.branch_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS branch from tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_position_branches tpb ON (tpb.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_degrees tpd ON (tpd.position_id=tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_degrees tdgr ON (tdgr.degree_id=tpd.degree_id) LEFT JOIN tp_branches tbr ON (tpb.branch_id = tbr.branch_id) LEFT JOIN tp_position_locations tpl ON (tpl.position_id = tp.position_id) LEFT JOIN tp_location_ap tl ON (tpl.location_id = tl.location_id) @@ WHERE @@ GROUP BY position_id ) as tp ORDER BY tp.position_title, tp.position_code

SELECT DISTINCT tps.skill_id as skill_id,ts.skill as skill_name FROM tp_position_skills tps LEFT JOIN tp_skills ts ON (ts.skill_id=tps.skill_id), ( SELECT position_id from tp_positions tp WHERE @@ ) tp WHERE tp.position_id=tps.position_id AND skill_type=? order by skill_name

SELECT DISTINCT tpl.location_id as location_id,tl.location_name as location_name FROM tp_position_locations tpl LEFT JOIN tp_location_ap tl ON (tl.location_id=tpl.location_id), ( SELECT position_id from tp_positions tp WHERE @@) tp WHERE tp.position_id=tpl.position_id order by location_name
select DISTINCT tp.dept_id as department_id,td.dept_name as department_name from tp_positions tp LEFT JOIN tp_departments td ON (tp.dept_id=td.dept_id) where @@ order by department_name
